stage: A4 fixed-threshold calibration after the structural pilot
prior_pilot_seen: The same 106-pair calibration block showed IR-only 399/413 TP and 26 background FP at IR 0.22; RGB 0.30/radius 0.13 showed 409/413 TP, 33 background FP and 1 duplicate. This rule is chosen after that pilot, so the diagnostic_dev result is descriptive development evidence.
hypothesis: A stricter RGB threshold or smaller match radius can retain some extra unique targets with fewer added false reports while preserving every IR-native prediction.
geometry: frozen original E1 affine; no FoV hard gate
matching: one-to-one Hungarian with explicit null, no ambiguity rejection in this grid
selection_rule: Among configurations with zero known different-ship merges and actionable false alerts per frame <= 0.30, maximize known unique TP; then minimize actionable false alerts, then duplicate reports, then prefer smaller radius and higher RGB threshold. If none has more unique TP than the IR-only baseline, select IR-only.
diagnostic_dev_after_selection: Run exactly one selected configuration and the IR-only comparison on the existing 121-pair diagnostic development block. It is not an independent held-out test because this project has viewed this block before.
preservation_gate: Every IR prediction at threshold 0.22 must occur exactly once in every report configuration. Empty RGB candidates must reproduce IR-only exactly.
limits: Working UIDs are evaluation-only. A raw black/blurred RGB network-input experiment is separate and is not simulated by this candidate-list search.
